title: [PCL] install failure

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:

Windows 11

### Compiler

MSVC vc143

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

```Shell
`./vcpkg install pcl[apps,core,cuda,opengl,openni2,qt,simulation,tools,visualization,vtk]:x64-windows`
```
